title: canarium oblongifolium
intro: Canarium oblongifolium, commonly known as the Black Dammar or Kanikur, is a species of flowering plant in the family Burseraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from pain, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Canarium oblongifolium include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate cough, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and fatty acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
